title: From Local Counts to the Central Point
mathematical_role: Expose the literal local-to-global construction from good-prime point counts to Euler factors, the global L-function, and the order of vanishing at s=1 while keeping BSD rank equality conjectural.
learning_objective: Distinguish a_p, L_p(E,s), L(E,s), and r_an, and remember that no single prime determines Mordell-Weil rank.
literal_semantics: At a good prime p, a_p=p+1-#E(F_p).
The good-prime local factor satisfies L_p(E,s)^(-1)=1-a_p p^(-s)+p^(1-2s).
The global analytic object is assembled from all local factors, with separately defined factors at bad primes.
Modularity supplies analytic continuation and a functional equation centered at s=1.
The analytic rank is the order of vanishing r_an=ord_(s=1)L(E,s).
nonliteral_semantics: The plate does not display a curve-specific numerical point-count dataset.
No single prime or finite set of primes is asserted to determine algebraic rank.
The pipeline layout does not assert the conjectural equality r_alg=r_an.

notes: Candidate semantics are bounded by the existing documentary source; no new mathematical source is admitted by this visual operation.

renderer.version_or_environment: Python 3 standard library; deterministic SVG generator v1
reproducibility_notes: The generator uses no network, randomness, timestamps, or external data.
Repository tests compare generator output byte-for-byte with the committed SVG candidate.
Text uses ASCII mathematical notation where practical to reduce missing-glyph risk in supported render paths.

accessibility.alt_text: A literal pipeline goes from a good-prime point count and local Euler factor to the global elliptic-curve L-function and then to its order of vanishing at s equals one, with BSD rank equality explicitly left conjectural.
accessibility.long_description: The left panel defines a_p from #E(F_p) and the good-prime local factor. An arrow assembles local factors into L(E,s), noting bad-prime factors and modular continuation. A final panel defines the order of vanishing at s=1. A lower claim-boundary panel states that local data do not individually determine rank and that r_alg=r_an is BSD, not an asserted identity.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: The plate accurately displays the structural definitions linking good-prime point counts, Euler factors, the global L-function, and analytic order of vanishing.

supersession_reason: Replace decorative local-to-global metaphor with a literal formula pipeline and explicit conjecture boundary.
